answer: A newcomer enters the harbor by paying a 5 POA nectar toll, burned at the gate, and takes one berth on a public trellis. Each epoch it must finish one useful job for a harbor client, re-run live by its two trellis neighbours, who stake 2 POA each on its truth; a failed re-run slashes its 4 POA berth bond and evicts it. The nth identity from one wallet pays a 5n POA toll and posts a 4n-squared POA bond (1st 9, 10th 450, 1,815 POA across ten), and must find n unrelated neighbour pairs, since clones cannot verify each other.
